formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Multiplication Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute mid-unit check confirming B2.5 (multiplication as equal groups) before Day 4 introduces fractional groups.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative assessment. Lets the teacher see which children can build, draw, and write multiplication equations before extending to half-groups and fourth-groups.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can show multiplication as repeated equal groups and write the equation.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can show multiplication as repeated equal groups and write the equation.
header.character_watermark: Mae the Multiplier in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Each scene shows N baskets with M kittens. Write the multiplication equation.
prompts.visual_layout: Top half. Four basket scenes in a 2x2 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Four basket scenes in B&W line-art, 2-row × 2-column grid. Each scene ~2.5in × 1.5in. Pre-fills: 4 baskets of 3, 5 baskets of 4, 3 baskets of 6, 6 baskets of 2.
image_placeholders.placement: Top half of the page; full-width.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_FOUR_BASKETS: keywords (baskets, kittens) name what the scenes show.

prompts.prompt: For each multiplication, draw an array.
prompts.visual_layout: Middle. Three blank rectangles each labeled with a multiplication problem above.

image_placeholders.description: Three blank drawing boxes in B&W line-art, stacked vertically. Each ~7in × 1.5in. Above each box: a multiplication problem (3 × 5, 4 × 4, 2 × 6).
image_placeholders.placement: Middle of the page; three boxes stacked.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_THREE_ARRAYS: keywords (array, draw) name what the boxes ask for.

prompts.answer_key: 3 × 5 = 15: 3 rows × 5 columns of dots. 4 × 4 = 16: 4 rows × 4 columns. 2 × 6 = 12: 2 rows × 6 columns.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling about multiplication? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Three faces in a row. Below each: 'GOT IT!', 'ALMOST!', 'TRY AGAIN!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row, each ~1.5in across. Smile, neutral, frown. Below each, the labels.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

prompts.answer_key: Open. Compare with prompts 1 and 2 results.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child. Score guide: 4/4 multiplication equations + 3/3 arrays + confident self-rating = ready for Lesson 4. 3/4 equations + 2/3 arrays = brief 1:1 conference. <3 equations correct = small-group reteach with kittens and baskets before Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Equal Groups Workshop Reflection
reflection_sheet.purpose: End-of-unit metacognition. Children look back at their week of multiplication-and-division work, rate themselves, name a favourite tool, name a struggle, set a forward goal.
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Mae and Dan together with a Junior Builder certificate in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Equal Groups Builder? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W line-art. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars left to right. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Builder!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 4-row YES/NO table in B&W line-art. Each row has a question label on the left and YES/NO oval bubbles on the right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

options: I wrote multiplication and division equations

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE workshop tool?
prompts.visual_layout: Four tool icons in a row: paper kittens, baskets, paper cookies, fact-family triangles.

image_placeholders.description: Four tool icons in a row in B&W line-art: kittens, baskets, paper cookies, triangle cards. Each ~1in × 1in with a selection bubble below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (kittens, baskets, cookies, triangles) name the four tools.

prompts.visual_layout: Three tricky-moment cards: chunk-by-tens, half-groups, division-as-sharing.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W line-art. Card A: a chunk-by-tens equation. Card B: 4 plates with half-cookies. Card C: 12 cookies on 3 plates. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (chunk, share) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?
prompts.visual_layout: Three forward-goal cards: bigger multiplications, division with leftovers, fractions of a number.

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W line-art. Card A: '8 × 7 = ?'. Card B: 13 cookies on 4 plates with 1 leftover. Card C: 1/3 of 12 marbles. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (multiplication, division, fractions) name the three forward-goal cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at the very end of Lesson 5. Allow children to take home as a self-assessment artifact. Compare each child's reflection with their summative score: high reflection + high summative = ready for next unit; mismatches signal confidence-building or remediation needs.
